reuse.why: The tree already decides a schedule's expected amount (missing gives 0, number gives itself, range gives the end furthest from zero) inline in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in shared/schedules.ts; the diff writes the rule again in api-models instead of extracting that into a shared helper and calling it.

duplication.why: The missing/number/furthest-from-zero ternary is a second copy of the preview logic, with a different tie rule (> instead of >=).

placement.why: Exposing the field in scheduleModel.toExternal is the right API layer, but the amount rule is a schedule-domain decision that belongs in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount and the preview code.

scope.why: Limited to the API model, its handler type and a test; the new type also changes the return type of toExternal for every caller, not only the list.

maintainability.why: Simple to read, but the API and the previews now each hold their own copy of the rule, and they already disagree on ties.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No exported helper for the furthest-from-zero amount exists to bypass; the existing rule is inline in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal: the preview's nested ternary is reshaped (a ?? 0 default, then > instead of >=) rather than shared.
